title: Physical, chemical and geometric effects starter pack

source.citation: Existing repository effects.json statements and function fields; textbook phenomena curated in this repository, not an external effects database.

review.note: Repository curation, not independent expert validation. All 74 entries have one conditional input/output clause; SI dimensions and layers are explicit declarations, not quantitative implementation models.

limitations: No application-specific operating envelope, magnitude, efficiency or physical sufficiency is established.

_meta.title: Effects starter database
_meta.purpose: Function-to-effect mapping for TRIZ synthesis: given a required function, find candidate physical, chemical, or geometric effects that deliver it.
_meta.provenance: Repository-authored summaries of established phenomena. External reference text is not reproduced. Every selected typing names a specific external reference; references do not establish every legacy application hint.
_meta.usage: Search all installed packs with triz_effects. Categories organize retrieval; related_effects records useful general/special-case links. Typings are explicit hypotheses, not sufficiency verdicts.

audit.scope: Screened the original 60 entries for obvious conflation, misleading guarantees, classification errors and retrieval gaps; targeted source checks support corrections and additions.
remaining_gaps: Opaque optical and field excitations deliberately lack SI dimensions until their quantitative interpretation is selected.
Each typing selects one unary clause, holding other inputs as stated assumptions; multi-input, quantitative and application-specific implementations remain expert work.
Conditional typings and targeted references are not independent expert validation of every legacy statement or application hint.

typing.source: Existing statements/functions and linked references, with SI declarations cross-checked against NIST SP 811.
typing.scope: One selected input/output clause per effect; conditions name other resources, operating assumptions and history. Endomorphisms are generators, not identities. No behavior, dynamics, feasibility, efficiency or sufficiency is inferred.

effects.statement: Like charges repel; with a suitable charge distribution, electrostatic forces can lift particles when they exceed opposing adhesion and other forces.
hints: electrostatic dust detachment under controlled charging
limitations: Repulsion must overcome adhesion and other forces; traveling-field electrodynamic screens also use field gradients and are a separate mechanism.

provenance.license: MIT (repository-authored summary; external reference text is not reproduced)

conditions: specified nonzero particle charge and field direction

effects.name: Thermal-expansion mismatch detachment
effects.function: remove a deposited layer or coating from a surface by heating or cooling it
effects.statement: A layer and substrate with different expansion coefficients develop mismatch strain as temperature changes; the resulting stress can crack or detach the layer.
hints: thermal-shock descaling of pipes and molds
cryogenic blasting that shrinks and embrittles coatings
releasing ice or wax by brief heating
limitations: Mismatch strain does not guarantee release; bond strength, geometry and material response determine the result.
